description: Protein complexes from CORUM and IntAct Complex Portal, represented by their set of base UniProt protein members. Records sharing the same protein set describe one complex, including records that differ in stoichiometry, assembly, isoform or mature-chain specificity. Stoichiometry is not stored. Complexes with a single protein member are included; every protein member must be represented in SPOKE. Protein members are linked to their complex by PARTOF_PpCP.

common_properties.name: identifier
common_properties.description: Composition-based identifier derived from the set of base UniProt accessions of protein members.
common_properties.notes: Complex:<decimal CRC32 of sorted, hyphen-joined base accessions>

common_properties.name: name
common_properties.description: Human-readable complex name from CORUM or IntAct Complex Portal.

common_properties.name: synonyms
common_properties.description: Alternative complex names from the contributing sources, including differing source names.
common_properties.notes: Flat, deduplicated, shared across CORUM and IntAct; property omitted when no synonyms

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time of the most recent creation or update.

source_contributions.scope: Experimentally characterized human protein complexes. GO, drug, disease, literature, purification-method and FunCat annotations are outside this contribution.
source_contributions.description: CORUM supplies complex identifiers, names, synonyms and experimental cell lines. Details from records sharing the same protein composition are retained in parallel lists.

properties.name: corum_ids
properties.description: CORUM identifiers for records describing this protein composition.
properties.notes: Ordered by numeric complex_id ascending; parallel-list spine

properties.name: corum_names
properties.description: Complex names for the contributing CORUM records.
properties.notes: Index-aligned to corum_ids; property omitted when a node has a single contributing record

properties.name: corum_cell_lines
properties.description: Experimental cell lines reported for the contributing CORUM records.
properties.notes: Index-aligned to corum_ids; empty cell_line stored as the literal string "none reported"

source_contributions.scope: Curated Complex Portal protein complexes across species whose NCBI taxonomy is represented by an Organism node in SPOKE. The HuMap predicted-complex file is excluded. Non-protein participants (chemicals, nested-complex references and RNA) and internal EBI identifiers are not represented in the protein composition. Records with alternative-accession groups or no protein members are excluded.
source_contributions.description: IntAct Complex Portal supplies CPX accessions, biological descriptions, assembly types and evidence codes. GO annotations, cross-references, ligand, disease, agonist and antagonist annotations are outside this contribution.

properties.name: intact_ids
properties.description: Complex Portal accessions for records describing this protein composition.
properties.notes: CPX accessions; ordered by numeric CPX ID ascending; parallel-list spine

properties.name: intact_evidence_codes
properties.description: Bare ECO evidence codes for the contributing records. ECO:0000353: physical interaction evidence used in manual assertion; ECO:0005543: biological system reconstruction evidence by experimental evidence from mixed species used in manual assertion; ECO:0005544: biological system reconstruction evidence based on orthology evidence used in manual assertion; ECO:0005546: biological system reconstruction evidence based on paralogy evidence used in manual assertion; ECO:0005547: biological system reconstruction evidence based on inference from background scientific knowledge used in manual assertion; ECO:0005610: biological system reconstruction evidence based on homology evidence used in manual assertion.

properties.name: intact_assemblies
properties.description: Assembly types reported for the contributing records, such as Heterotrimer.

properties.name: intact_descriptions
properties.description: Free-text biological descriptions of the complex.
properties.notes: Flat, deduplicated (NOT index-aligned); `-` omitted; property omitted if no non-`-` descriptions
